name: Akamai Cloud Monitor
description: The Sumo Logic Application for Akamai Cloud Monitor allows you to analyze and correlate Akamai data with origin data in order to improve availability and performance of applications, improve end-user experience, gain deeper user insights, and enforce rigorous security controls. The app uses predefined searches and dashboards that provide visibility into your environment for real time analysis of overall usage.

panels.name: 90%-ile Latency
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai*| parse "\"netOriginLatency\":\"*\"" as originLatency, "\"fwdHost\":\"*\"" as fwdHost
| timeslice 1m
| pct(originLatency, 90) as nintieth by fwdHost, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column fwdHost

panels.name: 90%-ile Latency
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai*| parse "\"netOriginLatency\":\"*\"" as originLatency, "\"originIP\":\"*\"" as originIP
| timeslice 1m
| pct(originLatency, 90) as nintieth by originIP, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column originIP

panels.name: Error Rate 5xx by Code
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* (500 or 501 or 502 or 503 or 504 or 505)
| parse "\"reqMethod\":\"*\"" as method, "\"status\":\"*\"" as status, "\"fwdHost\":\"*\"" as origin
| where status in ("500", "501", "502", "503", "504", "505") and method="GET"
| timeslice 10m as _timeslice
| count by _timeslice, status
| transpose row _timeslice column status

panels.name: Median Latency
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai*| parse "\"netOriginLatency\":\"*\"" as originLatency, "\"fwdHost\":\"*\"" as fwdHost
| timeslice 1m
| pct(originLatency, 50) as median by fwdHost, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column fwdHost

panels.name: Median
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai*| parse "\"netOriginLatency\":\"*\"" as originLatency, "\"originIP\":\"*\"" as originIP
| timeslice 1m
| pct(originLatency, 50) as median by originIP, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column originIP

panels.name: Error Rate 4xx by Code
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* 4??
| parse "\"reqMethod\":\"*\"" as method, "\"status\":\"*\"" as status, "\"fwdHost\":\"*\"" as origin
| where status matches "4*" and method="GET"
| timeslice 10m as _timeslice
| count by _timeslice, status
| transpose row _timeslice column status

panels.name: Slowest URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai*| parse "\"reqPath\":\"*\"" as path, "\"netOriginLatency\":\"*\"" as latency
| urldecode(path) as path
| max(latency) as max_latency by path
| sort by max_latency
| limit 10

panels.name: Top 404-Causing URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai*| parse "\"reqPath\":\"*\"" as path, "\"status\":\"*\"" as status
| urldecode(path) as path
| where status = 404
| count as errors by path | sort by errors | limit 25

panels.name: Top Error-Causing URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* 50?
| parse "\"reqPath\":\"*\"" as path, "\"status\":\"*\"" as status
| urldecode(path) as path
| where status > 499
| where status < 600
| count as errors by path
| sort by errors

panels.name: Map (Unique Visitors)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* | parse "\"cliIP\":\"*\"" as cliip
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code from geo://location on ip = cliip
| count_distinct(cliip) by latitude, longitude

panels.name: Download Performance Hotspots - Avg Download Above 300 by Country
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* cliIP downloadTime country|  parse "\"cliIP\":\"*\"" as ip | parse "\"downloadTime\":\"*\"" as downloadtime| parse "\"country\":\"*\"" as country_code
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=ip
| count as numhits, avg(downloadTime) as avg_download_time by country_code, latitude, longitude | round(avg_download_time)
| where avg_download_time > 300 and numhits > 1| sort by - avg_download_time

children.name: Akamai Cloud Monitor - Quality of Service

panels.name: Cacheable Content Download Times
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* netPerf downloadTime cacheStatus
| parse "\"cacheStatus\":\"*\"" as cachestatus, "\"downloadTime\":\"*\"" as result
| toInt(cachestatus) as cachestatus
| toInt(result) as result
| where  cachestatus > 0
| floor(result/100) * 100 as Response_Time
| if (Response_time > 2000, "2001", Response_Time) as Response_time
| count as Requests by Response_Time | sort by + Response_Time
| if (Response_time > 2000, ">2000", toString(Response_Time)) as Response_time

panels.name: Cache Performance
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* cacheStatus
| parse "\"cacheStatus\":\"*\"" as status
| where !(status="")
| if(status="0", "0 - Non cacheable", if(status="1" OR status="2", "1/2 - Cache Hit", if(status="3", "3 - Cache Miss", ""))) as cachestatus
| count by cachestatus

panels.name: Download Performance Hotspots - Avg Download Above 300 by Country
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* cliIP downloadTime country|  parse "\"cliIP\":\"*\"" as ip | parse "\"downloadTime\":\"*\"" as downloadtime| parse "\"country\":\"*\"" as country_code
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip=ip
| count as numhits, avg(downloadTime) as avg_download_time by country_code, latitude, longitude | round(avg_download_time)
| where avg_download_time > 300 and numhits > 1| sort by - avg_download_time

panels.name: Origin Download Times Histogram
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* netPerf downloadTime cacheStatus
| parse "\"cacheStatus\":\"*\"" as cachestatus, "\"downloadTime\":\"*\"" as result
| toInt(cachestatus) as cachestatus
| toInt(result) as result
| where  cachestatus = 3
| floor(result/100) * 100 as Response_Time
| if (Response_time > 2000, "2001", Response_Time) as Response_time
| count as Requests by Response_Time | sort by + Response_Time
| if (Response_time > 2000, ">2000", toString(Response_Time)) as Response_time

panels.name: Cache Offload Percentage Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* cacheStatus
| parse "\"cacheStatus\":\"*\"" as status
| if (status="1" OR status="2",1,0) as cache_offload
| timeslice 5m
| count as totalCount, sum(cache_offload) as cache_offload by _timeslice 
| toInt((cache_offload/totalCount)*100) as CacheOffloadPct | fields -totalCount,cache_offload

panels.name: Performance Stats by Country
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* cliIP downloadTime country
| parse "\"cliIP\":\"*\"" as ip 
| parse "\"downloadTime\":\"*\"" as downloadtime| parse "\"country\":\"*\"" as country_code
| toUpperCase(country_code) as country_code
| count as numhits, pct(downloadTime, 5) as pct_5, pct(downloadTime, 25) as lowerq, pct(downloadTime, 50) as median, pct(downloadTime, 75) as upperq, pct(downloadTime, 95) as pct_95,avg(downloadTime) as average by country_code
| round(pct_5) | round(lowerq)| round(median)| round(upperq)| round(pct_95)| round(average)
| sort by average

panels.name: WAF-Warn Requests per Host
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* waf warnRules reqHost
| parse "\"warnRules\":\"*\"" as warn, "\"reqHost\":\"*\"" as host
| where warn != ""
| timeslice 1m 
| count by _timeslice, host
| transpose row _timeslice column host

panels.name: Denials by Host
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* waf denyRules reqHost
| parse "\"denyRules\":\"*\"" as deny, "\"reqHost\":\"*\"" as host
| where deny != ""
| timeslice 1m
| count by host, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column host

panels.name: Top Warn Rules
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* !"\"warnRules\":\"\""
| parse "\"warnRules\":\"*\"" as warn |urldecode(warn)
| parse regex field=warn "(?<warn_rule>[\w-]+)" multi
| where warn_rule != ""
| count as %"Count" by warn_rule | sort by count

panels.name: Top Deny Rules
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* !"\"denyRules\":\"\""
| parse "\"denyRules\":\"*\"" as deny |urldecode(deny)
| where deny != ""
| count as deny_count by deny| sort by deny_count

panels.name: Top Warn URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai* waf warnRules reqPath
| parse "\"warnRules\":\"*\"" as warning_id, "\"reqPath\":\"*\"" as path | urldecode(path)
| where warning_id != ""
| count as warn_count by path
| total warn_count
| warn_count/_total*100 as percent
| fields - _total
| sort by percent
| limit 10

panels.name: Top Deny URLs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Akamai*| parse "\"denyRules\":\"*\"" as deny, "\"reqPath\":\"*\"" as path
| urldecode(path) as path
| where deny != ""
| count as deny_count by path
| total deny_count
| deny_count/_total*100 as percent
| fields - _total
| sort by percent
| limit 10

panels.name: Top Requests

|  parse "\"reqPath\":\"*\"" as reqpath | count by reqpath | sort by _count | limit 20
